summary: Tested the two authorised fixes with zero real AI calls and zero emails. (1) AI timeouts: re-ran test_ai_timeouts.py, test_workspace_final_smoke.py and test_calendar_notify.py with SMOKE_REAL_AI=0: 32 passed, 2 skipped. Code review checks: analyze uses a 90s wait_for, returns 408 with the 'Nessun credito è stato scalato' message, deducts the credit only after success, and returns 409 on concurrent analyze. Copilot uses 45s and returns 408, and App.js ask() shows detail when the status is 408. Assistant uses 25s per provider and then falls back. (2) Crea promemoria: new pytest test_reminder_from_analysis.py, 6/6 passed. UI e2e tested with a seeded contract analysis and a seeded 'other' analysis reopened from Storico. FOUND AND FIXED a CRITICAL bug: the reminder modal rendered inline, clipped inside the Results card, and blocked clicks. Two smaller UI fixes were also applied. After the fixes, every flow requested passes.

minor.issue: _ANALYZING is an in-process set, so it does not prevent double charges if the backend runs more than one worker or replica. Also, the credit $inc -1 has no {credits:{$gt:0}} condition. Fine for a single worker.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED. The .ws-panel (position:fixed) was rendered inside the .glass card. .glass has backdrop-filter, which makes that card the containing block for fixed children. The modal therefore appeared inline and clipped inside 'Dati Estratti', and it intercepted clicks on create-reminder-btn. Fix: the panel is now rendered with createPortal(…, document.body).
FIXED. The old 'Promemoria salvato' success message stayed on screen next to the 409 error on a later save. run() now clears done.

issues: FIXED. Adding the 'Crea promemoria' button made the Dati Estratti button row overflow the screen horizontally, pushing CSV/JSON off-screen. Added flexWrap to the header row and the button row.
FIXED. The note ran straight into the notify text ('1 gg primaTEST…'). Added a ' · ' separator.

design_issues.screen: Reminder modal after confirming the detected deadline
issues: After the auto deadline is confirmed, a 'new' editor appears prefilled with the same guess date (30/09/2027). Saving it always returns 409. Consider leaving the date empty or hiding the editor when the guess date is already confirmed.
The deadline edit form has no field for note, so a note can only be set from the reminder modal.

action_items: Optional: in ReminderFromAnalysis, don't prefill the 'new' editor with a guess date that is already confirmed
Optional: add note editing to the Deadlines.jsx edit form
Optional: make the analyze credit deduction atomic ({credits:{$gt:0}}) and use a DB-level lock if there will be more than one worker
critical_code_review_comments: Timeouts are implemented correctly with asyncio.wait_for. A 408 on analyze happens before the credit is deducted, so no charge. History is untouched.
Any position:fixed overlay rendered inside a .glass or .fade (transform) ancestor will be clipped. Use a portal for modals rendered inside Results.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after fixes (modal was 0% before the portal fix)

seed_data_creation: Fresh @example.com users, with analyses inserted directly into the DB (contract with expiration 30/09/2027, plus an 'other' analysis), and one anonymous session with an analysis. All of it was cleaned up. numberne@gmail.com was not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Results is reachable without AI calls by seeding db.analyses and using nav-history → history-item → history-reopen (nav-history is hidden at 390px: open on desktop, then resize). Dialogs need an async page.on('dialog') handler. The DateField next-month button matches '.rdp-button_next' / button[aria-label*=ext].
